methodology.control: Hunt permits movement. Protect disables movement keys but allows camera, attack and use; knockback can still move the player. Protect means self-defense, not escorting another character. SAM 2 tracks targets every five Protect steps; native Hunt retains its initial reference.
methodology.input: Initial SAM 2 points are supplied from the known scenario layout. Policies receive RGB, a target image/mask, numeric event ID 0 and previous actions. Live health, coordinates and kill counters are scorer-only. The released ROCKET-3 event mapping is not fully documented.
methodology.scoring: Clear means all zombies killed while alive within 600 steps. Counter deltas are episode-relative. Auto-respawn is scored as death, with zero remaining health.
methodology.repeats: Eight unseen placements/action seeds per situation (layouts 13–20), one fixed arena world. Minecraft entity AI randomness is not separately seeded. All references and nominees use the same frozen runtime, V100 GPU class and SAM BF16 autocast; policies are FP32. Results describe this benchmark.
